description: The graph illustrates the performance of two models—labeled "MATTER (ours)" and "w/o material information"—in terms of Macro-F1 Score (%) as a function of the Number of tokens. The x-axis, representing the Number of tokens, spans from approximately 0.6 to 1.4, with labeled tick marks at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis, labeled Macro-F1 Score (%), ranges from 48 to 58, with labeled tick marks at 48, 50, 52, 54, 56, and 58. The "MATTER (ours)" model, represented by a pink line with circular markers and a shaded confidence interval, shows a fluctuating trend: it begins at approximately 55.5% at 0.6 tokens, rises to a peak of about 59.5% near 0.8 tokens, and then generally declines to around 55.5% at 1.4 tokens. The "w/o material information" model, shown as a purple line with circular markers, starts at approximately 52.8% at 0.6 tokens, increases to a peak of about 57.2% near 1.2 tokens, and then drops sharply to approximately 52.5% at 1.4 tokens. Both lines exhibit variability, with the pink line showing more pronounced fluctuations, particularly a significant peak around 0.8 tokens.
